Package in.co.rays.proj4.model

Class BaseModel<T extends BaseBean>

java.lang.Object
in.co.rays.proj4.model.BaseModel<T>
Type Parameters:
T - Bean class extending BaseBean
Direct Known Subclasses:
AtmModel, CollegeModel, CourseModel, FacultyModel, GymManagementModel, LibraryModel, MarksheetModel, RoleModel, StudentModel, SubjectModel, UserModel
public abstract class BaseModel<T extends BaseBean> extends Object
BaseModel is an abstract parent class of all Model classes in the ORS Project. It provides common database operations such as adding, updating, deleting, searching and retrieving records. It uses JDBC to communicate with the database. All application Model classes inherit this class and implement its abstract methods according to their respective database tables.

  • Method Details

    • add

      public abstract long add(T bean) throws ApplicationException, DublicateRecordException
      Inserts a new record into the database. Child Model classes implement this method to insert records into their respective database tables.
      Parameters:
      bean - bean object containing record data
      Returns:
      generated primary key of the inserted record
      Throws:
      ApplicationException - if a database operation fails
      DublicateRecordException - if a duplicate record exists

    • update

      public abstract void update(T bean) throws ApplicationException, DublicateRecordException
      Updates an existing record in the database. Child Model classes implement this method to update records in their respective database tables.
      Parameters:
      bean - bean object containing updated record data
      Throws:
      ApplicationException - if a database operation fails
      DublicateRecordException - if a duplicate record exists

    • getWhereClause

      public abstract String getWhereClause(T bean)
      Generates the WHERE condition for database search queries. Child Model classes implement this method to create search conditions according to their requirements.
      Parameters:
      bean - bean object containing search criteria
      Returns:
      SQL WHERE condition as a String

    • getTable

      public abstract String getTable()
      Returns the database table name associated with the Model. Child Model classes implement this method to provide their respective table names.
      Returns:
      database table name

    • getBean

      public abstract T getBean()
      Creates and returns a new Bean object. Child Model classes implement this method to create their respective Bean objects.
      Returns:
      new Bean object

    • nextPk

      public Integer nextPk()
      Generates the next primary key value for the database table. Retrieves the maximum ID from the respective table and returns the next available ID.
      Returns:
      next primary key value

    • delete

      public void delete(long id)
      Deletes a record from the database using its primary key. Executes a DELETE SQL query on the respective database table.
      Parameters:
      id - primary key of the record to be deleted

    • findByPK

      public T findByPK(long id)
      Retrieves a single record from the database using its primary key. Executes a SELECT query and populates the Bean object with the retrieved database record.
      Parameters:
      id - primary key of the record
      Returns:
      Bean object if the record is found, otherwise null

    • search

      public List<T> search(T bean, int pageNo, int pageSize)
      Searches database records using the given Bean search criteria. Supports pagination to retrieve records page by page. The WHERE condition is generated using getWhereClause().
      Parameters:
      bean - bean object containing search criteria
      pageNo - current page number
      pageSize - number of records per page
      Returns:
      list of matching Bean objects

    • findByUniqueColumn

      public T findByUniqueColumn(String column, String value)
      Retrieves a record using a unique database column and its value. Executes a SELECT query using the specified column and searches for the matching record.
      Parameters:
      column - name of the database column
      value - value to search in the specified column
      Returns:
      matching Bean object if found, otherwise null

    • list

      public List<T> list(int pageNo, int pageSize) throws ApplicationException
      Retrieves all records from the database with pagination. This method does not apply any search filter. It retrieves records according to the given page number and page size.
      Parameters:
      pageNo - current page number
      pageSize - number of records per page
      Returns:
      list of Bean objects
      Throws:
      ApplicationException - if an error occurs while retrieving records

    • list

      public List<T> list() throws ApplicationException
      Retrieves all records from the database without pagination and without applying any search filter. Internally calls list(0, 0) to retrieve all records.
      Returns:
      list of all Bean objects
      Throws:
      ApplicationException - if an error occurs while retrieving records
